title: Spawner Pickaxe
description: Pickaxe spawner + mob eggs from villagers
body:
**⛏️ Spawner Pickaxe**

Spawner Pickaxe is a powerful and customizable plugin that allows players to mine mob spawners using a special pickaxe and expand trading options with villagers.

**✨ Main Features:**

* ⛏️ Mine mob spawners with a special Spawner Pickaxe
* 🧑‍🏭 Blacksmith villagers can sell the custom pickaxe
* 🧙 Cleric villagers can sell spawn eggs
* ⚙️ Fully configurable villager trades
* 💰 Customize prices, items, and trade availability
* 🔄 Enable or disable specific trades in the config
* 🥚 Add your own spawn eggs and adjust their cost
* 🚀 Simple and lightweight

**📜 Commands:**

* `/spawner_pickaxe reload` — reloads the plugin configuration
* `/spawner_pickaxe_reload` — alternative reload command

**⚙️ Configuration:**
The plugin is highly configurable:

* 💰 Set prices for the Spawner Pickaxe
* 🧑‍🏭 Configure villager trades (Blacksmith / Cleric)
* 🥚 Add or remove spawn eggs from trades
* 🔛 Enable or disable selling options
* 🛠️ Fully control everything through the config file

🎮 Perfect for survival servers that want to add more progression and trading mechanics!
